channel.title: Baltor components in this repository
channel.description: Base components in release 3ae8b538466f (12 items; variants omitted).

item.title: Baltor Public Good plugin marketplace
item.description: Marketplace listing for the free Public Good plugins in this repository, installable with /plugin marketplace add.

item.title: Baltor service MCP connection
item.description: MCP entries that connect Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode to the Baltor endpoint over streamable HTTP with a bearer token from the environment.

item.title: Block commits that stage credentials
item.description: PreToolUse hook that refuses a git commit when the staged diff contains something that looks like an API key or private key.

item.title: Claude Code settings for a media project
item.description: Project settings that allow ffmpeg/ffprobe and the catalogue tool, deny reading .env and credentials, and wire the secrets hook.

item.title: MP4 QA probe
item.description: Checks an exported MP4 with ffprobe: minimum duration, 1080x1920, H.264/yuv420p, AAC audio present. Exit 1 on any failure.

item.title: /render-short
item.description: Slash command that turns a topic into a full 60+ second house-style short: script with sources, spec, render, QA, then delivery.

item.title: Short-video house style
item.description: Current photographic contract for 60+ s vertical shorts: 972x1728 photo, moving 5% border, yellow hook at y~320, genuine frosted glass, layers <= 249/255, faithful captions.

item.title: Short-video rules reviewer
item.description: Reviews a rendered short and its spec against the house rules and returns pass/fail per rule with frame timestamps.

item.title: Short video spec
item.description: JSON Schema for one vertical short: hook title, 60+ s duration, scenes with layers capped at 98% opacity, captions, narration and credited music.

item.title: Short-video standing rules
item.description: Numbered, testable rule set for shorts with machine-readable thresholds (duration, opacity cap, title placement, caption sync).

item.title: Short Video Studio plugin
item.description: Claude Code plugin manifest bundling the house-style skill, the rules reviewer subagent and the /render-short command.

item.title: Instructions for a video render step
item.description: CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md section for a step that renders video: deliver full exports, keep stated rules, verify before sending.
